narratives.body: The LA Clippers are preparing for a new season with specific fan incentives and roster changes. Yahoo Sports and KTLA report that fans can access free parking and receive new jerseys on opening night, while NBC Sports notes that the team has swapped jerseys to mark the occasion. On the court, the roster is seeing its first significant action of the season, with NBC Sports reporting that Darius Acuff Jr. made a brutal debut against the Clippers, while Keegan Murray struggled mightily in the same matchup.
narratives.headline: Clippers open season with jersey swap, free parking, and rookie debuts
